correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives the two exact nonreduced special fibers and Jacobian ideal factorizations; their supports are disjoint from the three vertices, proving saturated decomposition. The cubic normalization is certified by a basepoint-free degree-three parameterization and node tangent cone; the conic is smooth with six transverse axis intersections. For characteristic away from 2,3, the sextic derivative conditions produce four noncoordinate ordinary nodes with Hessian determinant 3888, six unibranch axis cusps with explicit \(A(W^3-A^2)\) of type \(E_7\) after union with the corresponding axis, and three triangle nodes; Bezout forces irreducibility. The self-contained verifier recomputes the critical integral identities and witness calculations. Finite samples are not used to prove an all-prime assertion.
